title: Require explicit holder release in registration ACK contention regression
outcome: The registration ACK contention regression cannot pass after its unrelated holder releases only because its safety guard expires.
acceptance: Retain and inspect the unrelated holder's release outcome after releasing and joining both threads; safety timeout or disconnect must not produce a passing no-reacquisition assertion.
Keep the real background writer, existing causal diagnostics-lock discriminator and teardown-before-assertions schedule, without sleeps or performance thresholds.
